description: This file defines the AssignTemplateVariable class, which is a specialized expression node used in Twig's template engine to assign a variable within a template, with support for global scope assignment.

classes.name: AssignTemplateVariable
classes.description: A class representing an assignment expression for a template variable within Twig, allowing for variable assignment with optional global scope.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs an AssignTemplateVariable with a TemplateVariable object and an optional global flag.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the assignment statement into PHP code using the Twig Compiler.
